scope: Public paper/configuration/source inspection; no paper implementation executed on GPU

dpa_moe.experiment: Qwen3-30B-A3B; 10 WikiText2 test sequences of 4096 tokens
dpa_moe.k_meaning: number of precision chunks, not selected-expert count
dpa_moe.comparison_axis: Across routed dispatches at each fixed precision; not same-input, equal-byte mixed-allocation candidate ranking
dpa_moe.remaining_question: Whether diagonal and exact objectives select materially different equal-byte allocations on held-out inputs
dpa_moe.does_not_establish: Existing method failure or novelty of computing cross terms
dpa_moe.proposed_diagnostic_not_reproduction: OLMoE-0924 with RTN differs from DPA SharedScale AnyBCQ and its OLMoE-0125 experiments

packing.rule: int32 words; floor(32/bits) codes per word; pad final word; transpose packed matrix
packing.consequence: Equal nominal average bit width does not guarantee equal actual payload bytes

rtn.scope: Per-group affine RTN formulation only; not full GEMQ allocation/router training

example_script.issue: Router fine-tuning enabled in example; must be disabled in the fixed-routing diagnostic

requirements.action: No package/environment changes; initial objective diagnostic can use an independent PyTorch RTN reference without GEMQ's inference stack

gemq.local_adapter_issue: Installed transformers 5.20.2 uses stacked OlmoeExperts tensors; do not assume old expert ModuleList adapters work
